# FemiCore®

> FemiCore® is a Health & Fitness > Women's Health > Bladder Health Supplement. FemiCore® is a natural bladder health supplement made specifically for women. Rather than a general multivitamin, it is positioned as a targeted daily formula for women who want to support normal bladder comfort, control and urinary tract wellness as part of their routine. It is sold online through the official FemiCore® order page, where bundle packages are currently promoted at up to 80% off, and it is intended as a daily wellness supplement rather than a prescription treatment.
